name: Elaltitan
sum: Elaltitan is a large lithostrotian titanosaur from the Late Cretaceous of Chubut, Argentina, known from one partial postcranial skeleton.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: PVL 4628 and MACN-CH 217, with three dorsal and two caudal vertebrae, left scapula, humerus and radius, both ulnae, the right pubis and other bones.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Mannion and Otero 2012
